dct_description_sm: (1) Examine the chemical, biological, and hydrological processes occurring in wastewater treatment systems in six communities of Nunavut;  (2) Assess the performance and efficacy of the treatment wetlands;  (3) Develop design models and recommendations for use in the Canadian Arctic;   (4) Help communities maintain and improve stewardship of local water resources;  (5) Collect base-line date available for policy formulation regarding creation of treatment and effluent discharge standards.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> E. coli
Health sciences and contaminants -> Freshwater quality
dct_title_s: Assessing the use of natural and constructed wetlands for wastewater treatment in the Kivalliq region of Nunavut
